name: Elevate Image Zoom
description: Image field formatter that adds an Elevate Zoom hover/lens/inner magnify effect (and a multi-image gallery) to image fields.
library_dependencies: elevatezoom (jquery.elevatezoom.js) — third-party JS, manually installed to /libraries/elevatezoom/
project_description: Elevate Image Zoom provides a single image field formatter (plugin id elevate_image_zoom_formatter) that applies the third-party ElevateZoom jQuery plugin to core image fields. It offers five zoom types (basic, tint, inner, lens, mousewheel) and automatically renders a multi-value image field as a thumbnail gallery with a zoomable main image. Per-display settings control the display/zoom/thumbnail image styles, zoom type, tint overlay colour, zoom-window position and size, and lens size. The module depends on the ElevateZoom JavaScript library, which must be downloaded manually to /libraries/elevatezoom/jquery.elevatezoom.js; hook_requirements() reports an error until that file is present. It defines no routes, permissions, services or config entities.
